GBP drove 83 actions (16 calls, 25 directions, 42 web clicks) in 28 days with +5.56% WoW lift — only working channel, but 3-day GBP actions are 0 (Aug 23–25).

suggestions.text: Escalate LSA verification and stack test completion this week — both are confirmed blockers holding $5,000/mo Google spend at zero.
